language.title: Language Preference [Français]
language.description: Choose your preferred language for the app interface [Français]

finance.title: Pay Rates [Français]
finance.description: Set your daily pay rates. These will be used to calculate your weekly earnings. [Français]
finance.warning: These should only be changed on the week that pay rates change. [Français]
finance.sixDayBonusDescription: You automatically receive a flat £30 bonus when working exactly 6 days in a week (any route type combination). [Français]
finance.invoicingDescription: Choose how you handle invoicing and tax returns. Costs are deducted from your weekly standard pay. [Français]
finance.selfInvoicingDescription: Handle your own invoicing and tax returns [Français]
finance.versoBasicDescription: Professional invoicing + public liability insurance (requires Ltd company) [Français]
finance.versoFullDescription: Full invoicing + accounting + tax returns + insurance (requires Ltd company) [Français]

user.title: Profile Information [Français]
user.description: Update your personal information. Display name is required, while first and last names are optional. [Français]
user.displayNameHelp: This is how you'll be identified in the app [Français]
user.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone. [Français]

onboarding.title: Onboarding [Français]
onboarding.description: Restart the onboarding wizard to see the setup process again or take the interactive dashboard tour. [Français]

restartDialog.title: Restart Onboarding [Français]
restartDialog.description: Choose how you'd like to restart the onboarding process [Français]
restartDialog.fullOnboardingDescription: Start completely fresh. This will delete all your entered data (work days, van hires, settings) and begin from scratch. [Français]
restartDialog.tourOnlyDescription: Keep your data and just view the interactive dashboard tour. Your real data won't be affected. [Français]
restartDialog.warningText: This action cannot be undone. All work days, van hires, and settings will be permanently deleted. [Français]

deleteAccount.permanentHeading: This action is PERMANENT and IRREVERSIBLE [Français]
deleteAccount.permanentText: Once you delete your account, there is no way to recover your data. This is not a temporary deactivation. [Français]
deleteAccount.dataDeletedHeading: The following data will be permanently deleted: [Français]

dataList.profile: Your user profile and account settings [Français]
dataList.workDays: All work days and weekly pay data (every week you've tracked) [Français]
dataList.vanHires: All van hire records and deposit information [Français]
dataList.mileage: Mileage tracking and pay rate history [Français]
dataList.auth: Your authentication credentials (you will be logged out) [Français]

alternatives.stopUsing: You can simply stop using the app without deleting your account [Français]
alternatives.clearWeeks: You can clear individual weeks if you want to start fresh [Français]
alternatives.resetRates: You can reset your pay rates in Settings if they've changed [Français]

deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Final confirmation step for account deletion [Français]
deleteAccount.lastChance: Last chance: Enter your credentials to permanently delete your account [Français]
deleteAccount.passwordHelp: We need to verify your identity before deletion [Français]
deleteAccount.finalWarning: After clicking "Delete My Account Forever", your data will be immediately and permanently deleted. You will be logged out and cannot undo this action. [Français]
